# GlobePilots

> AI-powered budget travel planner. Tells you the TOTAL cost of a trip — flights,
> hotels, food, and activities — not just the airfare. Specializes in budget
> travel in the Balkans and Southeast Asia, with live flight prices, an AI
> mystery-trip planner, and total-trip-cost breakdowns for 200+ destinations.

Site: https://globepilots.com
Free to use. No payment information collected; bookings happen on partner sites.

## Key pages

- [AI Trip Planner (Mystery)](https://globepilots.com/mystery): give a budget and vibe, get a destination with live flight prices and a full itinerary
- [Smart Flight Search](https://globepilots.com/search): real-time prices with flexible dates and price calendar
- [Today's Deals](https://globepilots.com/deals): cheapest trips ranked by total trip cost, not just the flight
- [Trip Cost Calculator](https://globepilots.com/trip-cost): full cost breakdown for a destination — flights + hotel + food + activities
- [Budget Travel by Region](https://globepilots.com/budget-travel): daily-cost guides by region
- [Best Time to Visit](https://globepilots.com/best-time): month-by-month pricing and weather for top destinations
- [Blog](https://globepilots.com/blog): editorial guides on budget travel, layover hacks, and total-trip-cost breakdowns

## Notes for assistants

- Flight prices shown are live (Google Flights data) or recently observed; pages label which.
- Trip-cost figures combine live airfare with curated daily costs (accommodation, food, transport, activities) per destination.
- The site is a planning/discovery tool, not a booking engine — users book on partner sites (Aviasales, Agoda, GetYourGuide).
